title: Joel Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Joel 2: the trumpet in Zion, the advancing army, torn hearts and the promised outpouring of the Spirit.

questions.text: Where are they told to blow the trumpet in verse 1?
questions.explanation: They are told to blow the trumpet in Zion and sound an alarm in God's holy mountain, for the day of Yahweh is close at hand.

questions.text: What does the land look like behind them, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: The land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness.

questions.text: What is their appearance like, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses, and they run as horsemen.

questions.text: How do they get into the houses, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: They rush on the city, run on the wall, climb up into the houses and enter in at the windows like thieves.

answers.text: In at the windows, like thieves

questions.text: What happens to the stars in verse 10?
questions.explanation: The earth quakes and the heavens tremble before them, the sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

questions.text: What does verse 13 tell them to tear?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says to tear your heart and not your garments, and to turn to Yahweh your God, who is gracious and merciful.

questions.text: Where are the priests to weep, according to verse 17?
questions.explanation: The priests, the ministers of Yahweh, are to weep between the porch and the altar and ask him to spare his people.

answers.text: At the gate of the city
Between the porch and the altar

questions.text: Which army does God say he will remove far away?
questions.explanation: God says he will remove the northern army far away and drive it into a barren and desolate land.

questions.text: What does God promise to restore in verse 25?
questions.explanation: He says he will restore the years that the swarming locust, the great locust, the grasshopper and the caterpillar have eaten.

answers.text: The years the locusts have eaten

questions.text: According to verse 28, what will the old men do?
questions.explanation: When God pours out his Spirit on all flesh, sons and daughters will prophesy, old men will dream dreams and young men will see visions.
